Hi Elena,

Thanks for taking the time yesterday on the onboarding call. To move Copperline to PO-ready status we need a completed W-9 and one piece of secondary evidence that ties the signer to the legal entity and EIN. Two options that procurement can accept are: a) a notarized W-9 (scanned) with a bank letter on bank letterhead that confirms the account name and EIN, or b) an OTP (one-time passcode) verification flow issued by the vendor's bank followed by an emailed bank confirmation.

Quick asks so we can estimate timing:
- Who will sign the W-9? Please provide the signer's name and title (we typically need CFO/Finance or delegated signatory).
- Can Copperline provide a scanned bank letter (PDF) or do you prefer DocuSign for the W-9?
- If you prefer OTP, which bank can issue the OTP and how long does that process take on your side?

I've attached a draft W-9 (w9_draft_copperline.pdf) with fields filled to the EIN you shared on the call; we can update if there are any changes.

If we can get the signed W-9 + bank confirmation by EOD Thursday (04/25) procurement can clear a standard net-30 PO shortly after. If you anticipate a delay, let us know and we can provisionally stage the vendor but hold the PO until evidence arrives.

Best,

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Elena. A couple procurement-side clarifications so we don't have to loop back:
- EIN match: Procurement will validate the EIN on the W-9 against the IRS cross-check and our vendor registry. If there's any mismatch we will need a secondary ID (bank letter or government-issued business registration).
- Acceptable evidence: DocuSign W-9 + bank letter PDF OR notarized W-9 + bank letter. OTP bank confirmation is acceptable as alternate evidence, but we require a recorded transaction ID and the bank rep's name/email for audit trails.
- Redaction: Please remove full bank account numbers from any attachments and place only last four digits if necessary. We need the letterhead, signer's name/title, and EIN visible.

If you can send the DocuSign envelope to procurement@copperline.io and cc me, we'll trigger the HubSpot deal and mark the PO as pending verification. I'll also start the PO draft so the moment documents are cleared we can issue.
